rule: Cumulative Layout Shift per interaction ≤ 0.1. Every async insertion reserves its space.

reservationPatterns.images: Declare width + height OR aspect-ratio; use loading='lazy' + decoding='async' where appropriate.
reservationPatterns.media: aspect-ratio on video / iframe; poster images for video.
reservationPatterns.fonts: size-adjust, ascent-override, descent-override, line-gap-override to match fallback; font-display: swap; optional font-display: optional for tight budgets.
reservationPatterns.async-lists: Skeleton array matched to expected count; min-block-size reserved.
reservationPatterns.async-cards: Skeleton matches final shape; CSS aspect-ratio on images.
reservationPatterns.ad-slots: Explicit slot size; refuse dynamic-height ad units in primary reading flow.
reservationPatterns.banner: Reserve banner slot height from first render; do not inject above viewport start.

measurement.tool: web-vitals library or Chrome UX Report
measurement.perRoute: Collect CLS per route; alert when any route exceeds 0.1 at p75

refusal: display:none → display:block for async content that belongs in reading flow.
Late-injected banners that push content down.
Fonts that swap with significantly different metrics (produces visible reflow).
